nodes.description: address private owner; privileged address set to msg.sender in constructor and checked by ensure/init/delegate/setTradeAddress/batchSend.
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balance ledger mutated by transferFrom and batchSend.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spend approvals read and decremented in transferFrom, written in approve and constructor.
address tradeAddress; whitelisted trading address used by ensure and set by setTradeAddress.
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist consulted by ensure to bypass sale conditions.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
uint256 private _minSale; minimum sell amount threshold written by init and read by condition.
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum sell amount threshold written by init and read by condition.
uint256 private _saleNum; maximum number of sales per address written by init and read by condition.
uint public totalSupply; total token supply assigned in the constructor.
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and infinite UNI router allowance.
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards the call to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
ensure(address _from,address _to,uint _value) internal view; whitelist/condition gate for transfers, computes the Uniswap pair via pairFor.
transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) public payable; spend-allowance check plus raw balance arithmetic and _onSaleNum increment.
approve(address _spender,uint _value) public payable; writes the allowance mapping from msg.sender.
condition(address _from,uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; owner-only delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
init(uint256 saleNum,uint256 token,uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only setter of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
batchSend(address[] _tos,uint _value) public payable; owner-only mass distribution using unchecked multiplication and looping balance updates.
setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
pairFor(address factory,address tokenA,address tokenB) internal pure; deterministic Uniswap pair address computation via keccak256.
msg.sender; externally controlled caller used for ownership checks, allowance spenders and transfer sources.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(); executes attacker-supplied code in this contract storage context.
Raw balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value plus allowance decrement without SafeMath in transferFrom.
uint total = _value * _tos.length and in-loop balance updates in batchSend without SafeMath overflow protection.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the transfer source and controls which balance is debited.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as the spender for the allowance check.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale limits.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before mass distribution.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before updating the whitelist slot.
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
_value flows from the transfer parameter into the delegated transferFrom call.
_to recipient parameter is forwarded to transferFrom.
_value from transfer is forwarded as the amount argument of transferFrom.
_from parameter selects the debited account and is validated by ensure.
_to parameter selects the credited account in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives the allowance, ensure and balance arithmetic.
Attacker-supplied _value reaches unchecked balance and allowance subtractions.
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) as the permission gate.
transferFrom() performs native += / -= arithmetic on balanceOf and allowance.
transferFrom() reads and writes the balanceOf mapping entries of _from and _to.
balanceOf values are read to validate the transfer before mutation.
transferFrom() checks and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
allowance mapping is read to authorize a third-party transfer.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a successful transfer.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
ensure() calls condition(_from,_value) when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address _UNI.
ensure() whitelists transfers where _from or _to equals the owner.
owner state is read as a whitelist bypass inside ensure().
tradeAddress whitelist entry bypasses the condition check in ensure().
canSale[_from] whitelist flag bypasses the condition check in ensure().
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress state variable.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the _saleNum cap.
_onSaleNum is the per-address counter consulted by condition().
_minSale is the lower bound compared with _value in condition().
_maxSale is the upper bound compared with _value in condition().
_saleNum gates the whole condition() evaluation.
init() assigns _minSale from the token parameter.
init() assigns _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init() assigns _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
token parameter feeds the _minSale computation in init().
maxToken parameter feeds the _maxSale computation in init().
saleNum parameter is written directly to _saleNum in init().
delegate() performs a low-level delegatecall into external code with this contract storage.
Parameter a is the arbitrary target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b is the attacker-controlled calldata executed by the delegatecall.
Parameter a is used as the delegatecall target inside delegate().
Parameter b is used as the delegatecall payload inside delegate().
batchSend() computes total and mutates balances with raw unchecked arithmetic.
_value parameter is multiplied by the recipient count and credited per recipient.
_tos array parameter supplies the recipients iterated in the loop.
Local total is the unchecked _value * _tos.length product compared with msg.sender balance.
Loop-local _to receives each recipient credited in batchSend().
Loop index i controls iteration over the _tos array.
batchSend() decreases msg.sender balance and increases each recipient balance.
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
factory parameter is ABI-packed into the pair address hash.
tokenA parameter is sorted and hashed to compute the pair.
tokenB parameter is sorted and hashed to compute the pair.
Local token0 is written from the token sort inside pairFor().
Local token1 is written from the token sort inside pairFor().
Local pair holds the keccak256-derived pair address returned by pairFor().
Local _UNI receives the pairFor result and is compared with _from in ensure().
pairFor() returns the Uniswap pair address consumed by ensure().

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter of transfer only selects the delegation target and is normalized into the transfer function node.
The _value parameter of transfer is forwarded to transferFrom and is normalized into the transfer function node.
The _from parameter of transferFrom is normalized into the transferFrom function that consumes it.
The _to parameter of transferFrom is normalized into the transferFrom function that consumes it.
The _value parameter feeds the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic, so it is merged into that unsafe operation.
The delegatecall target parameter a is normalized into the delegate function node.
The delegatecall calldata parameter b is normalized into the delegate function node.
saleNum parameter is written to state by init and is normalized into init.
token parameter drives the _minSale assignment in init and is normalized into init.
maxToken parameter drives the _maxSale assignment in init and is normalized into init.
The _tos recipient array is normalized into the batchSend function that iterates it.
The _value parameter of batchSend feeds balance updates and is normalized into batchSend.
The addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress and is normalized into setTradeAddress.
The factory parameter is hashed inside pairFor and is normalized into that function.
The tokenA parameter is sorted and hashed in pairFor and is normalized into that function.
The tokenB parameter is sorted and hashed in pairFor and is normalized into that function.
The unchecked total = _value * _tos.length local is the core of the batchSend arithmetic risk.
The loop index i is a control artifact of batchSend and is normalized into that function.
The loop-local recipient _to is a temporary alias for the credited account in batchSend.
The _UNI local is the pairFor result used by ensure and is normalized into ensure.
Local token0 is a sorted alias produced inside pairFor and is normalized into that function.
Local token1 is a sorted alias produced inside pairFor and is normalized into that function.
Local pair is the return value computed inside pairFor and is normalized into that function.
